_comment: v1.11.5 - subsection markers for the Latin of the nine Book VII excerpts. Translations were written with their markers already in place and mark_sections.js skips a field that carries them. Boundaries from Perseus (CTS phi0448.phi001), word-exact. Eight are whole chapters; VII.77 takes sections 12-16 only and declares it with `range`, which is also why its citation names them. Two anchors need `overrides`: Perseus prints `Vbi` at VII.3.1 and VII.28.2 where the app now prints `Ubi`, so the anchor has to be respelled to match the app's text rather than the edition's. VII.73.2 needs one for a different reason: Perseus divides `Qua re` where the Latin Library writes `Quare`, and the matcher works on whole words.
